title: Everyday Phrases — Attending a Wedding
scene_zh: 參加婚禮 · 情境對話
title_quote: A big envelope came for us.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💍 實用參加婚禮必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Attending a Wedding
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的參加婚禮情境對話，從回覆喜帖、找座位到晚宴祝酒（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Attending a Wedding phrase pairs, from replying to the invitation to the toasts and the cake (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A big envelope came for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am so happy for him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half past four, it says here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it a church or a hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ə tʃɜrtʃ ɔr ə hɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is at the lake garden.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the small print.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says gifts are not needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, I want to give something.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just the two of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will write our names now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we need a phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This reply card is due Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I say we are coming?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I look in blue?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My suit needs a good clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop is on Fifth Street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy a new tie?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has a nice lake view.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine for one night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Book the room with two beds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they need our arrival time?
dialogue.zh: 他們要我們的到達時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will fill the gas tank.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pack the small bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in my coat pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the time on it still clear?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə taɪm ɑn ɪt stɪl klɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 上面的時間還看得清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plan works if it rains.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I hope it stays dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will drink some warm milk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 丹尼爾又寄來一張便條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the parking is easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back field takes many cars.
dialogue.zh: 後面那塊空地能停很多車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we visit the lake first?
dialogue.zh: 我們能先去湖邊逛逛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I will find the map.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we sign our names here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we take a photo here?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這裡拍照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, stand by the flowers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We left a card in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛft ə kɑrd ɪn ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我們把賀卡放進盒子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些席位卡是我們的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They show us where to walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you know the bride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A band plays in the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have a quiet room?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our groom waits near the arch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her dress shines in the sun.
dialogue.zh: 她的禮服在陽光下發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個歌手知道他們的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個小改動很打動人心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們一起點了一根蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那象徵兩個家合為一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the flame is so small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep down, we all felt it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are more on the tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你裙子上一點灰都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, those vows stay with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 尤其是那句小小的約定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天婚姻看起來很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 但真正過日子才要下功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In here the lights are warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這湯真的什麼都不用加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, these speeches make me laugh.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，這些致辭總讓我發笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他講了個上學時的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the first slice is ours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There goes the band, tuning up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask you to dance?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uncles and aunties fill the floor.
dialogue.zh: 叔叔嬸嬸們擠滿了舞池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By now the lights turn gold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他給我們看了一張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Party favors wait at the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each bag holds a honey jar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 標籤上還寫著我們名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will drive to the hotel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car is at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every speech stays in my mind.
dialogue.zh: 每段致辭都留在我的心裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們邀我們去新家坐坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send the note, then plan it.
dialogue.zh: 先把感謝卡寄出，再約日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, the front desk is awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我襪子上都壓出印子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 想到我們自己安靜的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long night, but a good one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還記得最後那首合唱歌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft music now, in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 此刻只有黑暗中的柔音。
